name: NCAA D-III Mid-Atlantic Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Lock Haven, PA · host Lock Haven · West Branch XC Course
headline: NCAA D-III Mid-Atlantic Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 5 Johns Hopkins won the women’s race with 37 points over No. 10 Carnegie Mellon (67) behind a 1-2 from Carter Brotherton (20:48.6) and Alexia Tubbs. No. 2 Johns Hopkins edged No. 10 Carnegie Mellon 39 to 41 for the men’s title, packing its scorers from fifth to 10th. Lebanon Valley’s Rory Lieberman won the men’s race in 24:56.8, 3.1 seconds ahead of Carnegie Mellon’s Matthew Short.
